concerns.question: What is in scope, and how do course variants relate?
How are application responsibilities and boundaries allocated?
Which real code constructs implement the design?
How does inference become a bounded execution loop?
How are workflows paused, resumed and recovered?
How is memory retrieved, persisted and governed?
How are external tools and model providers integrated?
What execution and storage environments are configured?
How are costs, failures and traces observed?
How are untrusted input and sandbox exposure managed?
How are learning, evaluation and architecture evolution governed?

viewComponents.name: ERPA cache hit and miss
viewComponents.note: Offline run method; cache hit bypasses context and persistence in the graph. Scope/invalidation require tests.

viewComponents.name: Approval interrupt and audit authority
viewComponents.note: The audit row, not the resume payload, is the observed execution gate. Authentication, binding and exactly-once behavior remain unverified.

viewComponents.name: Memory context assembly

viewComponents.name: Workspace MCP integration
viewComponents.note: Part 2 server failure wrapper verified; Part 3 integration edge inferred, not an authenticated trace.

viewComponents.name: Skill trial and promotion
viewComponents.note: The distinct activate/rollback path is not equivalent to promote; validate authorization and permitted states.

viewComponents.name: Run observability and cost
viewComponents.note: Ledger reports estimated/billed fields; no independent cost or latency measurement performed.

viewComponents.name: Agent run lifecycle
viewComponents.note: Graph nodes and statuses observed. Crash/error state not added without checking all callers.

viewComponents.name: Approval lifecycle

viewComponents.name: Skill version lifecycle
viewComponents.note: Conceptual lifecycle; activation/rollback is a separate operation not exhaustively modeled.

viewComponents.name: Part 3 harness source packages
viewComponents.note: Actual module names; diagram edges reflect observed calls.

viewComponents.name: ERPA graph code-level class
viewComponents.note: Actual class and operations; no fabricated inheritance.

viewComponents.name: Memory provider code-level view
viewComponents.note: Declared class names; inheritance and signature omitted until exact class declaration is checked.

viewComponents.name: Part 2 paper workflow
viewComponents.note: Simplified successful path through named graph nodes; review rejection and restart omitted from this view.

viewComponents.name: Part 3 research workflow
viewComponents.note: Budget and reflection added to paper workflow; no measured quality or cost claim.

viewComponents.name: Part 1 sandbox execution boundary
viewComponents.note: The registered callable executes on the host before sandbox execution. Only registered deterministic functions should enter this path; verify provider isolation independently.

viewComponents.name: Part 1 configured deployment boundary
viewComponents.note: Deployment mapping is inferred from Docker/Compose presence and Oracle factory; no claim about exact topology or a running instance.
